text: A woman with long, flowing red hair sits cross-legged on a glowing circular sigil. She has pale skin, an hourglass figure, and bright orange eyes. Her face is oval with defined features. She wears a white draped garment tied at the waist with blue beads, accessorized by a matching choker and bracelets. Her pose is static, hands resting near her thighs as she gazes upward. The setting appears dimly lit, with wooden furniture and vases in the background.
